svg.title: ThingsBoard 3.6 Queue management: DB, topic, notification and consumer lifecycle

g.text: ThingsBoard 3.6 Queue management: DB, topic, notification and consumer lifecycle
PostgreSQL commit, broker topic creation and notification delivery
have no shared transaction or outbox.
Runtime update on a Rule Engine service
Next data pack observes runtime configuration
A lost delete notification can leave consumers/topics after the row is gone.
Partition shrink also leaves high-numbered physical topics behind.
